parity_reason: No criterion differs by more than 1 (only count differs, 4 vs 5). The totals are 30 and 31, a difference of 1, and neither image has a critical defect, so all three conditions hold.

reference.summary: A white pelican with a long neck and orange beak rides a red bicycle across green grass under a sunny sky with clouds and speed lines. The drawing is clean and readable, with a stiff wing and a neck that slightly overlaps the body.

defects.what: The wing reaching the handlebar is a thin gray stroke that looks more like a stick than a wing
defects.where: the pelican's wing, from the body to the handlebar
defects.expected: A wing with some feathered width that clearly grips the handlebar

defects.what: The neck's outline runs over the body outline, so the lines cross where the neck meets the body
defects.where: the base of the neck on the body
defects.expected: The neck joins the body smoothly without crossing outlines

defects.what: The saddle is hidden under the body, so the seat contact is only implied
defects.where: the pelican's belly over the frame
defects.expected: The pelican visibly sits on a saddle

attempt.summary: A white pelican with a big orange beak pouch rides a red bicycle along a road with hills and trees. The drawing is clear and appealing, with small problems in the frame and the neck joint.

defects.what: The bicycle frame has no lower rear tube between the pedal crank and the rear wheel hub, so the rear triangle is incomplete
defects.where: the lower rear part of the bicycle frame
defects.expected: A complete bicycle frame whose rear section links the crank to the rear wheel hub

defects.what: The tip of the beak pouch almost touches the sun, so the two shapes merge visually
defects.where: upper right, the beak and the sun
defects.expected: The beak stands clearly apart from the sun, with sky visible between them

defects.what: The neck starts from a round blob on top of the wing and looks pasted on instead of growing out of the body
defects.where: the base of the pelican's neck
defects.expected: The neck flows smoothly out of the front of the body

defects.what: The body hides the saddle and the frame top, so it is unclear whether the pelican is sitting on the seat
defects.where: the pelican's belly and the saddle
defects.expected: The pelican is clearly seated on a visible saddle
